scenario_description: A pinned Python repository builds and runs without touching the host workspace.
expected: Build commands, image identity, duration, exit status, stdout, and stderr are retained.
The host source tree is unchanged after execution.
The checked-out commit and behavior-bearing artifact match the requested experiment.
observed: Pinned commit 621e4974ca25ce531773def586ba3ed8e736b3fc was fetched and checked out exactly.
The real repository unittest passed and add_one(41) produced the inspected JSON value 42.
CapEff was zero, NoNewPrivs was 1, memory/pids/CPU limits were observed, the host snapshot was unchanged, and no container remained.
notes: PASS applies to this frozen internal-runtime experiment only; it is not public-image release approval.
